kindness--noun.def: Behaviour that is friendly and helpful.
kindness--noun.ex: I will never forget her kindness.

ginger--noun.def: A hot-tasting root used in cooking.
ginger--noun.ex: Add fresh ginger to the soup.

infection--noun.def: An illness caused by germs entering the body.

tension--noun.def: A nervous feeling, or a state of tight pulling.

kindly--adv.def: In a kind way, or used in polite requests.

bold--adj.def: Brave and confident, or printed in thick letters.

whale--noun.def: A very large sea animal that breathes air.
whale--noun.ex: A whale appeared beside the boat.

dial--noun.def: The round face of a clock or a meter.

dial--verb.def: To press the numbers to make a phone call.
dial--verb.ex: Dial the code before the number.

lung--noun.def: One of the two organs used for breathing.

coal--noun.def: A hard black material burnt for heat.

filling--noun.def: The material put inside something, such as a tooth.

faint--adj.ex: There was a faint smell of smoke.

recovery--noun.def: The process of becoming well or successful again.

volunteer--verb.def: To offer to do something without being paid.

bleed--verb.def: To lose blood from the body.
bleed--verb.ex: His nose bled for a minute.

narrow--adj.def: Small in width from one side to the other.
narrow--adj.ex: The street is too narrow for buses.

observe--verb.def: To watch something carefully to learn about it.

cycle--noun.def: A series of events that repeats regularly.
cycle--noun.ex: The water cycle is taught early.

accidentally--adv.def: By chance and not on purpose.

conclusion--noun.def: A decision you reach after thinking, or the end of something.

designer--noun.def: A person who plans how things will look.

glorious--adj.def: Beautiful and impressive, or deserving great honour.

hatred--noun.def: An extremely strong feeling of dislike.

slight--noun.def: A remark or act that insults someone.
slight--noun.ex: He took her silence as a slight.

graduate--noun.def: A person who has finished a university course.
graduate--noun.ex: She is a graduate of Ankara University.

fry--verb.def: To cook food in hot oil.
fry--verb.exTr: Soğanları altın rengi olana kadar kavur.

electrical--adj.def: Relating to electricity or using it.
electrical--adj.ex: An electrical fault caused the fire.

institute--noun.def: An organization for research or teaching.
institute--noun.ex: He works at a research institute.

principle--noun.def: A basic rule or belief that guides behaviour.

compete--verb.def: To try to win against others.

compliment--noun.ex: He paid her a nice compliment.

democracy--noun.def: A system where people choose their government by voting.

myth--noun.def: An old story about gods, or a false common belief.
myth--noun.ex: That idea is just a myth.

helpless--adj.def: Unable to protect yourself or to act.
helpless--adj.ex: We felt helpless during the flood.

appetite--noun.ex: The child has a good appetite.

formal--adj.def: Following official rules, or suitable for serious occasions.
formal--adj.ex: Send a formal request in writing.

vain--adj.def: Without success, or too proud of your looks.

overcome--verb.def: To succeed in dealing with a problem.
overcome--verb.ex: She overcame her fear of flying.

destination--noun.def: The place you are travelling to.
destination--noun.ex: Our destination was a small village.

idol--noun.def: Someone greatly admired, or an image worshipped as a god.
idol--noun.ex: The singer was his childhood idol.

rank--noun.def: A person's position in an army or an organization.
rank--noun.ex: He rose to the rank of captain.

formula--noun.def: A rule written in symbols, or a fixed method.

bare--adj.def: Not covered by clothes or anything else.
bare--adj.ex: He walked on the bare floor.

butcher--noun.def: A person or shop that sells meat.

arrangement--noun.def: A plan that has been agreed, or the way things are placed.
arrangement--noun.ex: We made an arrangement for Monday.

examine--verb.def: To look at something carefully, or to check a patient.

candle--noun.def: A stick of wax with a string that burns for light.
candle--noun.ex: Light a candle on the table.

stream--noun.def: A small river, or a continuous flow.
stream--noun.ex: A stream runs behind the house.

stream--verb.def: To flow continuously, or to send video over the internet.

organ--noun.def: A part of the body with a special job, or a large instrument.
organ--noun.ex: The liver is a vital organ.

outer--adj.def: On the outside, or furthest from the centre.

luxury--noun.def: Great comfort that costs a lot of money.
luxury--noun.ex: A hot bath is a luxury here.

sunset--noun.def: The time when the sun goes down.

engineering--noun.def: The work of designing machines, roads and structures.

element--noun.def: One part of a whole, or a basic chemical substance.

broadcast--noun.def: A programme sent out on radio or television.
broadcast--noun.ex: The broadcast reached the whole country.

eternity--noun.def: Time without end, or a period that feels very long.
eternity--noun.ex: The wait felt like an eternity.

handy--adj.def: Useful and easy to use or reach.

pace--noun.def: The speed at which someone walks or something happens.
pace--noun.ex: He walked at a steady pace.

genetic--adj.def: Relating to genes and what parents pass on.
genetic--adj.ex: The illness has a genetic cause.

old-fashioned--adj.def: Belonging to the past and no longer modern.

plug--noun.def: The part you put in a socket, or a stopper for a hole.

invasion--noun.def: The act of entering a country or place by force.

affection--noun.def: A gentle feeling of liking someone.
affection--noun.ex: She spoke of him with affection.

absence--noun.def: The state of not being present.
absence--noun.ex: Her absence was noticed at once.

philosophy--noun.def: The study of ideas about life and knowledge.

anyhow--adv.def: In any case, or used to change the subject.

puzzle--noun.def: A game that tests your thinking, or something hard to explain.

wizard--adj.def: Extremely good at something, in informal British English.

celebrity--noun.def: A famous person, especially in entertainment.

wrist--noun.def: The joint between your hand and your arm.
wrist--noun.ex: He wears a watch on his wrist.

physics--noun.def: The science of matter, energy and motion.
physics--noun.ex: She teaches physics at a school.

income--noun.def: The money a person or a company receives.

boxing--noun.def: The sport of fighting with padded gloves.
boxing--noun.ex: He trains in boxing twice weekly.
